summary: Iteration 8 — Backend + frontend regression for UAO Conecta after the demo-login removal and Google/CORS rewrite. Wrote pytest suite backend/tests/test_iteration8_auth.py (32 tests, 100% pass) covering register/login/me/email-available/google/forgot/reset/CORS/authenticated regression endpoints. Frontend flows verified via Playwright on the preview URL: monitor login → dashboard 'Hola, Laura.', invalid credentials show auth-error, new student registration (native <select> role/program/semester) → dashboard with token in localStorage.uao_token, page reload keeps session, fake session_id callback lands at #/ with proper auth-error 'La autenticación con Google no fue autorizada o expiró.', google-login-button 302s to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/, forgot-password shows 503 SMTP-unavailable message, reset-password screen renders with validation. ONE integration bug: logout uses BOTH a custom LogoutDialog and a native window.confirm() in App.js, so confirming the modal triggers a second native browser confirm — a real user is asked twice, and headless automation is blocked outright.

integration_issues.issue: Double confirmation. Layout.jsx opens a custom LogoutDialog (data-testid=logout-dialog). Clicking logout-confirm-button calls onLogout, which in App.js `logout` (line 298) also calls window.confirm('¿Estás seguro de que deseas cerrar sesión?'). If the user clicks 'Sí, cerrar sesión' in the modal, they immediately get a second native browser confirm; users who dismiss it (or automation) stay logged in. Fix: remove window.confirm from App.js `logout` since LogoutDialog already gates the action.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/App.js, remove the `window.confirm(...)` block (lines 299–300) inside the `logout` function; the LogoutDialog in Layout.jsx already asks for confirmation before calling onLogout, so the native confirm is redundant and blocks logout in browsers where the confirm is dismissed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js `logout` mixes UI concerns: it fires window.confirm AFTER the custom modal already confirmed. Remove the native confirm.

Login.jsx uses native <select> elements for role/program/semester (fine for a11y), but tests / callers must use page.select_option (not shadcn get_by_role('option'))—consider standardising with the rest of the app or documenting.
server.py is still large (previous iterations flagged); no change this iteration.

rca_of_the_issue: Cerrar sesión bug: App.js line 299 `const confirmed = window.confirm(...)`. Path: Layout.jsx logout-button → setConfirmLogout(true) → LogoutDialog opens → user clicks logout-confirm-button → onConfirm=() => { setConfirmLogout(false); onLogout(); } → App.js logout() calls window.confirm(). If confirm is cancelled/dismissed (or headless without dialog handler), the function returns early and the user stays logged in. Deleting the two lines fixes the double-confirm and unblocks automation.
